title: Reading Drill — Improving noticeboards for low vision — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Improving noticeboards for low vision — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Brackenton began with reports of leaves and posters partly obscuring public notices. The access adviser had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using viewing trials and chose reading accuracy at a distance as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was high-contrast lettering. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted nine weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded changes in light as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
